description: Re-export a map bought with make_map, free for 7 days: change labels, annotations, styling, overlays or page elements. The frame must stay the same -- address or center, groundWidthM, pageSize, orientation, dpi. Requires the mapId make_map returned.

address.description: US street address, city and state. Geocoded via the US Census.

annotations.description: Callouts to draw. Placement, collision avoidance and leader lines are automatic.

anchor.description: panel: top-left corner as fractions of the page. Omit to dock the panel beside the place it points at.

at.description: [lon, lat]. Required for tenant_callout and traffic_count.

body.description: panel: a grid of logos, one large logo, a photo, or header only.

boxColor.description: CSS colour for the label box fill.

id.description: Your id for this annotation. Echoed back in warnings so you can match them up.

inkColor.description: CSS colour for the label text.

image.description: Your own logo as a data: URI (PNG, JPEG or WebP).

name.description: Brand name, looked up for a public-domain logo.

markColor.description: CSS colour for the pin and leader line.

monogram.description: subject_pin: up to three characters shown in the pin, e.g. initials.

network.description: route_shield: interstate, US route or state route.

offset.description: Move the label box relative to its pin, in preview pixels (the page is 1397 wide at 11x17 portrait). Setting this turns the auto-placer OFF for this annotation, so it is the fix for a label_overlap warning you want resolved a specific way.

outline.description: panel: the offset frame. Default on.

path.description: [[lon,lat],...] along the road. Required for road_label.

photo.description: panel: a photo as a data: URI (PNG, JPEG or WebP), up to 8 MB.

stat.description: panel: the figure in the header, e.g. "100,000+ jobs".

strokeScale.description: Multiplier on pin, leader and outline weights.

stylePreset.description: light reads on dark pavement and roofs in shadow; dark reads on bright roofs and sunlit parking; accent is survey orange, meant for the subject property only.

textScale.description: Multiplier on text size. Lower it to clear a text_truncated warning.

width.description: panel: width as a fraction of the page.

brandsOnly.description: Keep only recognised chains. A flyer wants anchors, not every barber.

mode.description: site drafts tenants and road names; regional drafts cities, highway shields and water. auto picks regional for frames 3000 m wide or more.

autoLabel.description: Draft tenant callouts from OpenStreetMap and road names from Census TIGER before drawing your own. Use this when you do not know what is at the location. Pass an object to control how many: fewer labels is the simplest cure for a crowded page.

center.description: [longitude, latitude] in WGS84. Alternative to address.

groundWidthM.description: True ground width of the frame in meters. 500 fits a typical retail plaza; 20000-40000 makes a regional map, where autoLabel drafts cities, highway shields and water instead of tenants.

imagerySourceId.description: Imagery source id. Defaults to the sharpest source covering the frame.

labelScale.description: Text size multiplier applied to every annotation that does not set its own textScale. Drop to ~0.8 to fit more labels; raise for a map read at arm’s length.

mapId.description: Revise a map you already bought. Returned as X-Map-Id on your paid export. Re-exports are free for 7 days as long as the FRAME is unchanged — change labels, styling, overlays and page elements freely; changing address, center, groundWidthM, pageSize, orientation or dpi makes it a different map.

overlays.description: Thematic layers drawn under the annotations. A legend is added automatically. fema-flood: regulated floodplain (blank means no mapped hazard — FEMA draws Zone X with no symbol). nwi-wetlands: USFWS National Wetlands Inventory.

pageElements.description: Page furniture. Turn elements off to free up room for labels.

insetZoomOut.description: How many times wider than the frame the inset covers.

locatorInset.description: A small USGS topo overview showing where this frame sits in the wider area, with the frame outlined on it. Worth the corner it costs whenever the reader may not know the town.

title.description: Title block heading. Defaults to the address.

titleBlockScale.description: Size multiplier for the title block.

name: revise_map
title: Revise a map you bought (free)
